components.expression:
SELECT
    UnifiedssotEntpUserAisr__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS UnifiedUserId__c,
    ssot__EntpUser__dlm.KQ_Id__c AS DataSource__c,
    top_results.sender__c AS SourceUserId__c, 
    top_results.recordId__c AS ContentId__c,
    MAX(top_results.affinity__c) AS Affinity__c
FROM (
    SELECT
        counts_by_day.sender__c AS sender__c,
        counts_by_day.recordId__c AS recordId__c,
        SUM(
            (CASE counts_by_day.action__c
                WHEN 'crud-create' THEN 10
                WHEN 'crud-update' THEN 5
                WHEN 'crud-read'   THEN 1
                ELSE 0 END)
            * EXP(-0.00005 * DATEDIFF(counts_by_day.date__c, DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW())))
        ) AS affinity__c,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY counts_by_day.sender__c 
            ORDER BY SUM(
                (CASE counts_by_day.action__c
                    WHEN 'crud-create' THEN 10
                    WHEN 'crud-update' THEN 5
                    WHEN 'crud-read'   THEN 1
                    ELSE 0 END)
                * EXP(-0.00005 * DATEDIFF(counts_by_day.date__c, DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW())))
            ) DESC
        ) AS rank_val
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            EnterpriseUserActivity_std__dlm.EnterpriseUserId__c AS sender__c,
            EnterpriseUserActivity_std__dlm.ContentId__c AS recordId__c,
            EnterpriseUserActivity_std__dlm.InteractionType__c AS action__c,
            DATE_TRUNC('day', EnterpriseUserActivity_std__dlm.Timestamp__c) AS date__c
        FROM EnterpriseUserActivity_std__dlm
        WHERE EnterpriseUserActivity_std__dlm.SourcePlatform__c = 'LEX'
          AND EnterpriseUserActivity_std__dlm.InteractionType__c IN ('crud-create', 'crud-update', 'crud-read')
    ) AS counts_by_day
    GROUP BY counts_by_day.sender__c, counts_by_day.recordId__c
) AS top_results
JOIN ssot__EntpUser__dlm ON ssot__EntpUser__dlm.ssot__Id__c = top_results.sender__c
JOIN UnifiedLinkssotEntpUserIdentityAisr__dlm ON (
    UnifiedLinkssotEntpUserIdentityAisr__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__EntpUser__dlm.ssot__Id__c
    AND UnifiedLinkssotEntpUserIdentityAisr__dlm.KQ_SourceRecordId__c = ssot__EntpUser__dlm.KQ_Id__c
)
JOIN UnifiedssotEntpUserAisr__dlm ON UnifiedssotEntpUserAisr__dlm.ssot__Id__c = UnifiedLinkssotEntpUserIdentityAisr__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c
WHERE top_results.rank_val <= 3
GROUP BY 
    UnifiedssotEntpUserAisr__dlm.ssot__Id__c,
    ssot__EntpUser__dlm.KQ_Id__c, 
    top_results.sender__c,
    top_results.recordId__c

SELECT
   ssot__GoodsProduct__dlm.ssot__Id__c as ProductId__c, SUM(ssot__SalesOrderProductEngagement__dlm.ssot__OrderedQuantity__c) as TotalSoldUnits__c from ssot__SalesOrderProductEngagement__dlm 
JOIN
   ssot__GoodsProduct__dlm
ON 
   ssot__SalesOrderProductEngagement__dlm.ssot__ProductId__c = ssot__GoodsProduct__dlm.ssot__Id__c group by ssot__GoodsProduct__dlm.ssot__Id__c
